column1: # The servers a browser is told to use to find a way to another caller.
# The first row names the columns, as a browser reads them; each row
# after it is a server: its urls, then a username and a credential
# where it wants them. None by default, which reaches the same machine
# and the same network. The JSON list the system gives under the name
# `ice` of data/line.tsv, when there is one, is used instead.
